---
format:
  typst:
    margin:
      x: 0.6in
      y: 0.5in
---

```{=typst}
#set page(fill: white, numbering: none)
#set text(font: "Helvetica Neue", size: 10pt, fill: rgb("#4A4A4A"))

// ── Maroon header banner ──
#place(top + left, dx: -0.6in, dy: -0.5in,
  rect(
    width: 100% + 1.2in,
    height: 1.8in,
    fill: gradient.linear(rgb("#98002E"), rgb("#6E0022"), angle: 135deg),
    radius: (bottom-left: 12pt, bottom-right: 12pt),
  )
)

// ── Header text ──
#v(-0.15in)
#align(center)[
  #block(width: 100%)[
    #set text(fill: white)
    #text(size: 9pt, weight: "semibold", tracking: 2pt, fill: rgb("#DBCBA0"))[FALL 2026 · BOSTON COLLEGE]\
    #v(6pt)
    #text(size: 20pt, weight: "bold", tracking: 0.5pt)[Research Practicum in]\
    #text(size: 22pt, weight: "bold", tracking: 0.5pt)[Replicable & Reproducible]\
    #text(size: 22pt, weight: "bold", tracking: 0.5pt)[Cognitive Neuroscience]\
    #v(4pt)
    #rect(fill: rgb("#BC9B6A").transparentize(70%), radius: 12pt, inset: (x: 12pt, y: 4pt))[
      #text(size: 10pt, weight: "semibold", tracking: 1pt)[PSYC4172-01]
    ]
  ]
]

#v(0.35in)

// ── Course info boxes ──
#let info-box(label, value) = {
  rect(
    width: 100%,
    radius: 6pt,
    stroke: 0.5pt + rgb("#e0e0e0"),
    inset: 10pt,
  )[
    #set text(size: 8.5pt)
    #text(fill: rgb("#888"), weight: "semibold", size: 7pt)[#upper(label)]\
    #linebreak()
    #text(fill: rgb("#4A4A4A"), weight: "bold", size: 10pt)[#value]
  ]
}

#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr, 1fr),
  gutter: 8pt,
  info-box("Instructor", "Dr. Jason Geller"),
  info-box("Day & Time", "Thu 4:00–6:30 PM"),
  info-box("Location", "McGuinn Hall 332"),
  info-box("Semester", "Fall 2026"),
)

#v(0.15in)

// ── Description ──
#rect(
  width: 100%,
  radius: 8pt,
  fill: rgb("#F9F6F0"),
  inset: 14pt,
  stroke: none,
)[
  #set text(size: 11pt)
  This hands-on practicum introduces students to the principles and practices of *open, replicable, and reproducible psychological science*. Students work in teams to design and conduct a close replication of a published psychology experiment using the Human Neuroscience Laboratory (HNL).

  By the end of the course, you will have completed a preregistered replication study, produced a fully reproducible research report, and presented your findings in a conference-style poster session.
]

#v(0.15in)

// ── Hex sticker centered ──
#align(center)[
  #image("images/hex-sticker.svg", width: 3.2in)
]

#v(1fr)

// ── Bottom banner ──
#rect(
  width: 100%,
  radius: 8pt,
  fill: rgb("#98002E"),
  inset: 16pt,
  stroke: none,
)[
  #set text(fill: white)
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    gutter: 16pt,
    align(horizon)[
      #text(size: 13pt, weight: "bold")[Interested? Questions?]\
      #v(2pt)
      #text(size: 10pt, fill: rgb("#DBCBA0"))[Contact Dr. Jason Geller · Department of Psychology & Neuroscience]\
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 10pt, fill: rgb("#DBCBA0"))[Boston College · McGuinn Hall]
    ],
    align(horizon + center)[
      #rect(fill: white.transparentize(85%), radius: 8pt, inset: 10pt)[
        #text(size: 14pt, weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#BC9B6A"))[PSYC4172-01]\
        #text(size: 8pt, fill: rgb("#DBCBA0"))[Fall 2026]
      ]
    ]
  )
]
```
